messages:
maria: FYI we deployed ptq-lite-canary last night. Early telemetry shows an uptick (~2%) in funcall JSON parse failures for streaming replies. Error log: `funcall_parse_error: unexpected EOF while parsing` 

devon: is this isolated to streaming or do non-stream endpoints fail too?

maria: streaming only so far. mirrored live traffic to canary. sample shows stray control bytes at chunk boundary — looks like NUL or low-bytes between chunks which breaks our ndjson coalescer.

kai: can you paste the raw chunks? if the runtime appends packed kv prefixes as binary and the proxy treats them as text we get escaped sequences.

maria: raw (from proxy logs):
```
{"delta":"...\\u0000","finish_reason":null}
{"delta":"\\"}\\n","finish_reason":"stop"}
```
The first chunk ends with a NUL, next chunk starts with an escaped quote + newline; joining them yields `...\\u0000"}\\n` which json.loads rejects.

eval-bot: telemetry snapshot: parse_error_rate(ptq-lite-canary)=0.023 over 6h; baseline(raven-v2-q8)=0.0004. top routes: tool-invoke, web-search, reranker.

sam: maybe quantization changed tokenizer byte packing. Did the quant tool change any encoder/decoder tables or perform byte-trimming?

kai: quick local repro: with prefix-cache on + continuous batching we can recreate boundary NULs. pseudo-repro:
```
# pseudo
reqA -> stream chunk A ends 0x00
reqB -> stream chunk B begins '\"}'
coalesce -> '...\\u0000"}\\n' -> parse fails
```
Possible that kvcache sends compacted frames containing 0x00 and our upstream escapes them yielding literal `\\u0000` in the text stream.

devon: suggested mitigation: (1) disable kv-prefix caching for canary for 1 hour, (2) run 1k replay of failing traces with strict streamer, (3) add temporary sanitizer to strip lone control chars before final JSON parse and archive raw bytes for postmortem. Opinions?

maria: +1. sanitizer should be staging-only short-term. Need runtime instrumentation to capture raw frame hex for repro. @kai can you add sampled hex-dumps (no PII) and a flag to treat 0x00 as non-printing so it's not emitted into text frames?

kai: will add sampling and a small patch to the streamer to ignore NUL when serializing text frames. also will check whether transfer-encoding (gzip vs chunked) differs between canary and prod.

sam: also plan quantitative check: run FP32 original model with same batching/cache config; if FP32 does not emit NULs but PTQ does then quantization step likely introduced compaction bug.

maria: filed INF-4289 and disabled kv-prefix caching at 1815554620. initial smoke slice shows immediate drop in parse errors. starting replay now. ETA ~45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

devon: if sanitizer removes >90% failures we can promote fix; otherwise rollback canary.

maria: update 1815554921: replay completed on 1k traces. sanitizer (locally) reduced parse failures by 95% on the failing set. capturing runtime hex-dumps and attaching to INF-4289 for deeper root cause analysis. :thumbsup:
